observations: The page number «17» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «3» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. A dark speck stands before «Selsk.» in it.

L01-L06 end chapter 22 (p. 16, JP2 0048). L07: the heading of chapter 23, in bold, centred; in the right margin beside it «C 71v, O 129r», and beside L08 «N 37r», the folios at which the chapter begins.

L08-L27: the sine, «elgeib» (al-jayb), in italics; «elgeib planum», the sine, and «elgeib diminutum», «elgeib elmankuz» (al-jayb al-mankūs), the versed sine, found as sixty less the sine of the complement for arcs below ninety degrees, and as sixty plus the sine of the excess for arcs above (L18-L25): the table of sines is for a radius of sixty. L20: «[planum]», the editor's square brackets upright, the word in italics.
The colons and semicolons of the text stand after the thin space of the edition (9-14 px measured); a light speck after the semicolon of L15 is not transcribed.
